modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
I gave FLUX 3 Max, MiniMax H3 Max Turbo, Kling 4.0 and Seedance 2.0 the same 4 photoreal stills and the same prompts: a face with a spoken line, a laughing group, hands with poker chips, and a burning street.

Full prompts & results below: https://t.co/0IaupwvndM

originalPrompt: Slow crane down into the smoke-filled city street. Flames ripple and flicker out of the building windows, glowing embers drift through the thick haze, and smoke rolls slowly between the towers. Dim headlights glow through the smoke at street level. Low roar of fire, distant sirens.
